'''Martin Arcimovic''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Rogue 33 from Praha, Czech. The fan site's Squadron Members table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist" />
